question: Which district has the higher population density in 2025, Brightwater or Millbrook, and by how many residents per square kilometre?

log.user:
Which district has the higher population density in 2025, Brightwater or Millbrook, and by how many residents per square kilometre?

Reply with the ANSWER line only. Do not show any working.
End your reply with exactly one final line in this format:
ANSWER: <district name or yes/no> | <number>
Write the number as a plain number (no units, no thousands separators), rounded to 3 decimal places.

calls.text:
Brightwater: population 44,675 (2025), area corrected to 921.4 km² (NR-16 supersedes 912.4). Density = 44,675 / 921.4 = 48.4 approximately.

Millbrook: population 37,203, area 758.6 km². Density = 37,203 / 758.6 ≈ 49.0.

Compute more precisely:
Brightwater: 44,675 / 921.4. 921.4 × 48 = 44,227.2; remainder 447.8; 447.8/921.4 = 0.48601. So 48.48601.
Millbrook: 37,203 / 758.6. 758.6 × 49 = 37,171.4; remainder 31.6; 31.6/758.6 = 0.04166. So 49.04166.

Millbrook is higher. Difference: 49.04166 − 48.48601 = 0.55565.

More precisely: 31.6/758.6 = 0.0416557; 447.8/921.4 = 0.4860199. Difference = 49.0416557 − 48.4860199 = 0.5556358 ≈ 0.556.

ANSWER: Millbrook | 0.556
